description: This file defines the SettingsProvider class, which manages theme settings (light/dark mode) in a Flutter application using ChangeNotifier for state management. It also provides a static method to ensure environment variables are loaded from a .env file.

classes.name: SettingsProvider
classes.description: A provider class that manages theme mode and notifies listeners on changes.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Switches between light and dark theme modes and notifies listeners.

methods.name: ensureLoadedEnv
methods.description: Asynchronously loads environment variables from the .env file.
